HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.title: Hecate
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.0-: May moonlight guide you on your path and blind your enemies.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.1-: ...heart of wormwood, earth-apple, spider silk, wax-stone...
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.3-: Continue your task. Our enemy is distracted.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.4-: May you cast a tall shadow in the light of the Moon.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.5-: I leaden your foes with the weight of my curse. So mote it be.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.6-: You have returned to us, as has your strength. Go use it well.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.7-: Push yourself hard, {character}, but do not break.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.8-: Our enemy is distracted. Find him, and strike him down.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.9-: You learn and grow each time that you set out. Continue on.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.10: Proceed at pace. No task of any consequence can be completed without effort.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.11: Much left to do both on the surface and below...
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.12: We witches oft are underestimated. But I am well aware how capable you are.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.13: The Architect is old enough to think that he has nothing left to learn, the utter fool.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.14: Your power hinges on your confidence. Do not allow yourself to falter.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.15: Recover as you must. Returning thus is not a backward step.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.16: Do not relent, {character}. Our enemy most certainly shall not.
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.17: ...moly petal, cypress leaf, mandrake root, quartz dust, garlic...
HADESANCIENTS-HECATE_ANCIENT.talk.firstV: Time forced our hand, {character}. Nary a soul expected you to slay our enemy last night, on a new moon, no less! But, you accomplished something of great import.
I lack such forgiveness for my failure, Headmistress Hecate. The Titan yet lives, and Olympus yet burns, while I'm back where I started! What is it I accomplished?
You're here to speak of it! Recovered in body, if not in spirit. You've not failed; merely begun. Thus may you learn, grow stronger, and complete your task. Death to the Architect.
